messages:
Eli: Quick heads-up — I'm going to split the existing 'json guardrails' doc into two PRs: 1) schema + examples, 2) parsing patterns + SDK snippets. Aim is smaller reviews and clearer migration guidance. Opening draft PRs now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 and https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/843. Needs owners for each. Thoughts?

Maria: sounds good. I'll take schema + examples (PR 842). I'll start by extracting the examples we have in examples/structured-output -> examples/schema.md and add a couple of compact examples for nullable arrays.

Cheng: thanks @Maria. For SDK snippets: do we keep them with parsing patterns PR or put a slim set with schema PR? I think parsing patterns should own the dynamic examples (fallback heuristics) because it's more runtime focused.

Sam: +1 to Cheng. Keep static schema examples (types, required fields) with schema PR. Put parsing heuristics, fallback code, and function-calling examples in parsing PR.

Alisa: I'll volunteer to audit links and fix any references for both PRs. Saw a couple broken links in the parser section earlier. I'll open a link-only PR if folks want me to stop blocking review.

Ben: quick note — linter found some fenced JSON blocks missing language tag; small nit but will fail CI. Example: ```json
{"output": {"type": "object"}}
```

DocsBot: Reminder — use the docs PR checklist, add the 'migration-notes' label if you're breaking examples that users might follow verbatim.

Eli: thanks. Also need a short migration blurb for SDK 3.x -> 4.x calling patterns. @Cheng can you draft the code snippet for fallback envelope examples? Something like:
```js
// parsing fallback pseudo
const parsed = tryParse(json) || {errorDetected: true, raw: json};
if (parsed.errorDetected) { /* fallback to regex parse */ }
```
Keep it concise.

Cheng: will do. One question: do we need to change the example filenames? I propose moving schema examples to docs/schemas/ and parsing to docs/parsers/. That will make redirects easier.

Maria: fine with that. I'll update the links and add front-matter so the sidebar picks them up.

Alisa: I'll run a quick grep for old paths and prepare a redirect map in a separate PR.

Sam: timeline? can we aim to land both PRs by EOD Friday? I can review schema PR early Thursday.

Eli: EOD Friday works. If anyone is blocked, ping me and I'll carve out time. Thanks all :rocket:

Maria: merged PR 842 (schema + examples) — small follow-up to address Ben's lint nit in a patch PR.

Cheng: pushed parsing PR draft (843) with SDK snippets and fallback examples. tagging reviewers.

Alisa: link PR coming in 10m — will include redirect map and a short note for the changelog.

Eli: perfect. Leaving notes in both PRs about the migration blurb so Product can pick it up for release notes.
